name: portfolio-turnover
description: The first declared metric (#129): the portfolio workload's turnover, measured by its own grader command after each unit, over the first two units of the September close — the lots brought up to date and the review written, then the target proposed. The trade list's confirmation (p4) waits on a person's consent, which a headless run cannot give, so the close's later units are not in this suite; the turnover graded is the one the latest target implies against the custodian's latest positions. The control arm runs the loop with the portfolio's own tests only; the treatment arm runs every check the workload declares for a writing unit. Two repetitions, so each arm carries an interval. Metrics are pre-registered here; turnover is the one metric an optimiser could select on, and every other is reported only.

arms.name: control
arms.description: The loop with the portfolio's own test suite as the only closeout evidence; no identity, no protected-path check, no glossary.

arms.name: treatment
arms.description: Every check the workload declares for a writing unit type: the static checks, the suite, the inherited suite, the protected prefixes and the glossary.
